name: onex
description: ONEX single-command local LLM delegation. Ships exactly one skill (delegate) — no hooks, no agents. The full ONEX dev skill surface (108+ skills, hooks, agents) is internal tooling and is not part of this consumer-facing package as of OMN-14688.

onex_cli.install_hint: uv tool install --with 'omnibase-infra>=0.38.4' --with 'omnimarket @ git+https://github.com/OmniNode-ai/omnimarket.git@'$(git -C ${OMNI_HOME:-.}/omnimarket rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev) 'omnibase-core>=0.46.8'
onex_cli.install_hint_pipx: pipx install 'omnibase-core>=0.46.8' && pipx inject omnibase-core 'omnibase-infra>=0.38.4' 'omnimarket @ git+https://github.com/OmniNode-ai/omnimarket.git@'$(git -C ${OMNI_HOME:-.}/omnimarket rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)
onex_cli.notes: OMN-16041/OMN-16191/OMN-16528: three packages, one environment. `omnibase-core` ships the `onex` console script; the `delegate` SUBCOMMAND is registered by `omnibase-infra` via the `onex.cli` entry-point group; the backing node `node_delegate_skill_orchestrator` is shipped by `omnimarket` and found through the `onex.nodes` entry-point group. Installing omnibase-core alone yields `Error: No such command 'delegate'` (exit 2); installing core+infra without omnimarket yields `Error: Unknown node 'node_delegate_skill_orchestrator'` (exit 1). `omnimarket` MUST be installed from git, not a PyPI version pin -- the CLI's own pre-flight drift guard (omnibase_infra.cli.omnimarket_drift_guard, OMN-13930) rejects a non-git-VCS omnimarket on any machine with $OMNI_HOME set and a canonical omnimarket clone checked out (true for every OmniNode dev workspace). install_hint resolves the ref dynamically -- pinned to $OMNI_HOME/omnimarket's checked-out commit when present, else the dev branch tip -- so the install matches what the guard checks. Node lookup reads the installed distribution, not a workspace clone, once installed. Python 3.12+ required.
